• I think you need to exercise daily at least 15 min
• I suggest joining to a local gym → you can find there
a fitness program that Il help you to lose weight
8. Quit smoking
• I'm afraid that smoking will have a great role in the
degeneration of your condition
• I know it can be challenging at 1st but I can discuss
with you some cessation strategies
* Would you like to go through this?
 
• Actually we've some remedies like
1. Nicotine patch
2. Some medications also can help like zyban
* Would you like to try this?
9. Insulin
• I totally realize that it may be difficult at 1s so how
about attending our weekly training programs?
*Is it okay with you?
10. Stress management    She
• To manage your stress I think you need to tollow
some relaxing techniques.
* Would you like to discuss that?
• First of all you need to reduce working hours
• It's important to eat healthy diet
• Reduce alcohol consumption & caffeinated drinks
11. Sleep hygiene approaches
• For comfortable sleep you need to follow healthy
habits of good sleep
* Would you like to try this?
1. Regular rhythm is v. important → one of the main
ways to treat your insomnia
2. Avoid caffeinated drinks & alcohol
3. Have a hat bath before sleeping time
4. Make sure that sleeping environment pheasant
 
Important tips
1. No obligation
2. Feel sorry for any family member who has a medical
problem
3. Listen carefully to your pt, especially when complaining
4. Eye contact is not necessary it's better to focus on your
preparation
5. Never to ask your patient multiple questions at the
same time
6. No open Qs
12. Questions to detect whether the patient has depression or
not
• Have you had any $ like
1. Suicidal thoughts
2. Lack of energy
3. Less of appetite
4. Insomnia
5. Night mares
